SkillBridge Fellowship Training Plan

This document describes the SkillBridge fellowship of Renata Okafor-Bell hosted by Copperline Rail Logistics, from 14 Oct to 8 Jan. Duty station is the Marion intermodal yard.

Instructor Qualification: Mentorship and instruction will be provided by Tomas Herrera, Senior Yard Operations Manager at Copperline Rail Logistics. Tomas holds a Class I dispatcher certification and has supervised twelve prior fellows.

Job Title: Intermodal Operations Fellow

Job Description: The fellow will rotate through yard planning, gate operations, and dispatch, learning how intermodal freight is scheduled, staged, and turned.

Responsibilities:
- Shadow yard planners during morning switch planning
- Maintain accurate gate transaction logs
- Assist with chassis inventory reconciliation
- Prepare the daily yard utilization summary

Skills to be Developed:
- Operations Planning
- Data Entry & Records Accuracy
- Radio Communication Protocol
- Safety & Compliance Procedures

Weekly Hours: Expect approximately 40 hours per week on a rotating schedule. Weeks spanning the winter holidays follow the yard's reduced holiday roster.
